notes.albums: Three albums: player version (2), kids set (2), fan version (3).
notes.captionOrderFix: The 22:09 'player version' album was harvested BEFORE the Brighton team marker and so was attributed to Crystal Palace. The garments settle it - p389 and p390 carry the Brighton crest and the American Express sponsor. captions.tsv was reordered so the Brighton marker precedes that album and align-0905.mjs re-run: 664 assigned, zero drift, nothing left over. This is the second reordering in this batch (see Newcastle), and both were caused by messages sharing one minute.
notes.dedupe: Two hash hits, p393 and p394. The store titles this club 'Brighton & Hove Albion' while the batch calls it Brighton; the club gate matched anyway because 'brighton' is a substring of the full name.
